question: Which materials for vessels, such as clay, tortoise, bell metal, and copper, are enumerated to the goddess?
premises: Vessels made of clay are mentioned
Vessels derived from tortoise are mentioned
Vessels made of bell metal and copper metal are mentioned
inference: Several material types for vessels are listed in response to the goddess
plain_english: O Goddess, vessels may be made of clay, born of tortoise, made of bell metal, or born of copper.
